items.title: Pay workshop invoice
items.computation: Payment period runs from the invoice date, 13.05.2025 (Tuesday). Under §187 Abs. 1 BGB, the day of the triggering event (invoice date) is not counted, so counting starts 14.05.2025. A period of 21 days ends 21 days after the start day, i.e. on 03.06.2025 (13.05. + 21 days: May has 31 days, 13+21=34, 34-31=3 → 03.06.2025). This is a payment to a private company (Autohaus in NRW, payer also in NRW), so NRW public holidays apply for a weekend/holiday shift, but 03.06.2025 is a Tuesday and not a public holiday, so no shift under §193 BGB is needed.
